title: Codex review verdict
description: Shape of a Codex consult that the consult-codex skill verifies finding by finding. Every property is required and no extra properties are allowed, which structured output enforcement expects.

verdict.description: no-findings only after the whole scope was read; cannot-answer when the scope was missing or unreadable.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what was reviewed and the overall conclusion.

scope_read.description: Files or refs actually read, so a no-findings verdict can be checked for coverage.

line.description: 1-based line, or null when the finding is not tied to one line.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

evidence.description: The code or behavior that shows it, quoted or described precisely enough to be checked.

suggestion.description: A fix or a test that would catch it, or an empty string.

unchecked.description: Things in scope that could not be assessed and why.
